component.name: Setup Assistant
component.summary: Set up Kulan OS the way you like it

description.p: Shown once at your first sign-in, like a Mac's Setup Assistant: choose light, dark or automatic mode and an accent colour, turn on accessibility options, make your computer more private, bring files over from another computer, set up backups and a password vault, install popular apps in one go, and see which protections are on.
